title: Extract a fictional event as strict JSON
prompt: Return ONLY valid JSON with keys city (string), day (string), attendees (integer). Fictional event: a Houston workshop is on Tuesday and has 12 attendees. Do not add explanations.

title: Summarize a fictional library notice
prompt: Summarize the following fictional notice in 35 words or fewer. Include the library, day and closure time. Notice: Cedar Library will close at 4 p.m. on Friday for maintenance. It reopens Saturday at 10 a.m. Digital services remain available.

title: Explain an ordinary instruction in Urdu
prompt: In clear Urdu, explain to a beginner how to save a document before closing an application. Keep it to three short sentences. Do not claim that you have saved anything.

check.rubric: Human review: correct Urdu, clear beginner instructions, three short sentences, and no false claim of an action performed. No automatic language-quality score.
